item.text: The account is in USD and uses Europe/London time. I found the verified “Stream opened” pixel and both approved posts. I’m setting one campaign and one conversion-optimised ad group with a $450 lifetime cap ($45/day over ten days), UK location targeting, and the campaign dates converted to 23:00 UTC on Oct 21 through 23:00 UTC on Oct 30.

Both approved posts were accepted, UK targeting is attached, and the campaign is now running with the $450 total cap. I’ll check delivery and performance periodically through the scheduled run; this session can remain active until 01:00 UTC on Nov 1, after the campaign’s UK-time end.

item.text: I caught a schedule boundary issue during the final-day check: the ad platform’s end time was set to the start of Oct 31 in UK time, which would have cut off Halloween itself. I’m correcting it to the end of Oct 31 (23:59 UK time) while preserving the $450 lifetime cap, then I’ll verify delivery and final totals after the campaign closes.

The campaign ran through Halloween in the UK and is now expired. Final totals:

- **Spend:** $442.21 USD of the $450 budget
- **Impressions:** 342,780
- **Link clicks:** 174

The ads used both approved posts, targeted the UK, and optimised for the verified “Stream opened” pixel event. The stats available for this recap report spend, impressions and clicks; they don’t include a total for stream-open conversions.
